title: Shape Shifting: Vehicle Race
playerPromise: Switch eight transport types across fair, varied courses; certify level data before production graphics.
firstAction: Play, then a useful family-slot tap within five active seconds in the first course.

input.touch: one pointer; release within 12 CSS px; Ground/Water/Air; optional left/right tap or 24 px swipe
input.keyboard: 1/2/3, arrows for branches, Enter/Space action, Escape menu without host trapping

loop.start: restore acknowledged Journey or start a bank course
loop.action: read support, change slot, choose route
loop.retry: same-course retries 1-2 free; 3 one rewarded video; repeat at 6/9/12; reset on advancing; immediate sub-10-second resets free
loop.nextJob: next prevalidated bank recipe; no terminal stage

invariants: perfect lawful play can earn Gold
rules.scoreFormula: acknowledged Journey stages cleared; optional reporting, no SDK enabled in QA harness
rules.win: genuine full finish; Gold first, Silver second, Bronze third
rules.failure: mistakes slow/wait safely; normal Next stays free; every third meaningful same-course retry uses one explicitly chosen rewarded video, with unavailable/error free fallback

content.seedPolicy: deterministic versioned candidate and frozen exact bank recipe
content.difficultyCurve: 36 teaching stages then fixed Standard/optional Expert profiles; no unbounded speed escalation
content.antiRepetition: motif rejection, 12 structural/64 exact recent guards; curated bank order

progression.restartPolicy: new serial/same graph/seed; shared persisted Retry/Restart/Replay counter; reset only when advancing to another course
progression.corruptSaveRecovery: protect and Retry; isolated unsaved practice only

presentation.camera: UNSPECIFIED; QA uses semantic text/progress controls only
presentation.motion: No production presentation selected; diagnostic progress only
presentation.audio: absent from level harness; host production audio NOT RUN
presentation.hud: diagnostic support, three actual vehicle controls, positions, result
presentation.successReveal: textual rank and measured time in diagnostic harness

monetization.status: approved specification; documented only; runtime implementation pending
monetization.interstitialPlacement: ordinary Next after visible result; every five genuine completed new Journey races
monetization.rewardedPlacement: explicit same-course Retry/Restart/Replay at retry ordinals 3, 6, 9, 12 and subsequent multiples of three
monetization.retryReset: advance to a different course; not reload, Resume or menus
monetization.meaningfulRetryAttempt: completed race or at least 10 active racing seconds; immediate shorter resets free and uncounted
monetization.optionalReward: one full retry of the same immutable course/loadout/seed; ordinary Next remains free
monetization.rewardReceiptIdPolicy: stable vehicle-shift-full-retry-v1 reward type and internal one-use request token
monetization.noFillPolicy: unavailable/unsupported/error allows free retry fallback; cancelled/unearned grants no rewarded retry; ordinary Next remains free
monetization.stackingPolicy: one ad per transition; rewarded request restarts the five-new-race interstitial window; no replacement interstitial on reward decline
monetization.implementationNote: historical D source/fixtures and diagnostic ZIP unchanged; ADS531-536 NOT RUN

performance.coldLoadProfile: 1.6 Mbps down, 150 ms RTT; SDK included in measurement

acceptance: all eight transports and both AI profiles
no human-enjoyment or host certification claim

successfulAnalogues: contract E1/E2/E5 with observed metrics and limitations
